title: Relic HUD — In-run relic slot display
description: Show active relics as icon slots in the HUD during gameplay. Position: bottom-right area above ground. Each slot shows relic icon (emoji) and a colored border. Empty slots shown as dim outlines. Max 3 slots (or 2 if RELIC VAULT trait not purchased). Also show World Omen as a small banner/tag on top-right during run (abbreviated omen name + color). This gives players visual feedback on their build at all times and surfaces the omen's presence throughout the run.
